comment: The bodies become provided methods of ContinueLoginHostLikeCpp (where Self: Sized), so `self` stays `self` and the scenarios' method calls resolve to the trait method. Field reads name the World host impls of the same split (verified: LootSessionHostLikeCpp::split_inventory_ref, CharacterLoginHostLikeCpp::split_lifecycle_ref and SpellbookHostLikeCpp::split_spell_state_ref are crate::session::split_*_ref(self); `.0` is the field the base read). Two host methods are new: the identity-completeness predicate and the guild-id read, each the same-named WorldSession method. The continue-login host's required sync method becomes the provided one (its World impl retires). (Two tokenizer-only spellings: rustfmt writes the where clause with a trailing comma, and `.0 .` keeps the tuple index and the method call as separate tokens, as rustfmt's line break does in the head.)
